text:
mel: Heads up — ZenView shows negative prefetch savings for tenant `alpha` around midnight, small amounts but weirdly consistent.
raj: I noticed that spike too. looks like an aggregation issue, maybe double-counting when a prefetched token gets billed later on hotpath.
sasha: Could be attribution ordering. @ops-bot can you pull the raw slice for tenant alpha 2026-03-20 00:00-02:00 (sample 1%) so we can inspect token lineage?
ops-bot: running slice query... returning sample id `slice-20260320-00a` — attached first 50 rows (prefetch_id, invocation_id, token_delta, charged_model). see tail: `prefetch_42,null,-0.003,gptx-4q` etc.
tara: Hmm, I see `token_delta` negative when `invocation_id` is null and later a follow-up invocation claims the same prefetch. The sampler is emitting a negative credit row and the invoicing / viz aggregator then sums both.
mel: Repro steps I used in staging:
```
-- staging quickcheck
SELECT prefetch_id, session_id, invocation_id, SUM(token_credit) as s
FROM prefetch_samples
WHERE tenant='alpha' AND ts between '2026-03-20' and '2026-03-20 02:00'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
HAVING s < 0
```
We get ~120 rows with s < 0.
raj: Quick patch idea: clamp prefetch_savings at 0 when session attribution is unresolved (session_id IS NULL) and surface a warning in the UI about "unattributed credits" so customers don't get confused.
sasha: That would hide legitimate negative refunds when eviction happens and the prefetch is actually reverted. We shouldn't silently mask real negatives.
mel: :thinking_face: What about adding an explainability line in the console card: "Negative savings due to unattributed prefetch credits — inspect sample" with a link to the raw sample id.
ops-bot: just pushed a small staging job that dedupes rows where prefetch_id appears with both negative and positive deltas within the same session window. job id `job-8482`. Running CI.
tara: Also want an alert rule: if daily `prefetch_savings_sum` < -$1 for any tenant, page the owners so we catch regressions before UI hits customers.
mel: Can we get a canary for the console change (tooltip + link) in tomorrow's frontend patch? I'd prefer UX + data fix together so the dashboard doesn't show scary negatives during the rollout.
raj: Agreed. I'll own the data-side fix, sasha will review runtime semantics, tara will add alert and docs.
sasha: I'll add a test that simulates post-eviction refunds to ensure we still surface real negatives when they truly occur.
mel: Cool. Tagging this thread for the rollout checklist: add note under "cost dashboards" -> "prefetch explainability". thanks everyone.
ops-bot: CI passed for `job-8482` and staging slices show aggregate delta moved from -0.42 to -0.01. will promote to canary if no further issues.
mel: Nice. Follow-up: once canary is up, let's run a smoke query and ship a short blurb for release notes explaining the UX change.
